shared_elements: low-relief figural scene occupying the upper part of the field
repeated schematic filler motifs filling a lower band (text lines / reed-and-water pattern)
justification: Both depict human figures in strict profile in shallow relief, with a densely filled band of small repeated motifs occupying the lower portion of the field (rows of signs in one, a reed-and-water marsh pattern in the other). Otherwise the subjects are unrelated: A shows symmetrical adorants with raised arms beneath a rayed disc above columns of script, while B shows a narrative chariot scene with horses, a spoked wheel, helmeted riders and weapons, none of which recur in A.
